name: Wow the Customer
definition: We exist to transform customers' lives for the better. The customer is the beginning and the end in every decision we make.

rows.under: Starts from the technology or the org chart, then looks for a customer to justify it.
rows.justRight: Names the customer and the change in their life first, then works backwards to what gets built.
rows.over: Rewrites the whole plan every time one customer says something, so nothing ever ships.

rows.situation: When the metric improves and the experience does not
rows.under: Ships the metric win and calls the job done.
rows.justRight: Treats the gap as a defect and goes to look at what the customer actually got.
rows.over: Refuses to move any metric until every part of the experience is perfect.

rows.under: Answers the ticket and closes it. The cause survives.
rows.justRight: Fixes this customer's problem now, then fixes the reason it happened so the next customer never sees it.
rows.over: Escalates every complaint into a company-wide project regardless of how many customers it touches.

rows.situation: When the easy path is easier for us than for the customer
rows.under: Picks the path that suits the team and hopes the customer does not notice.
rows.justRight: Pays the internal cost so the customer pays nothing, and says out loud which side the convenience is on.
rows.over: Loads so much cost onto the team that the team can no longer serve the customer at all.

rows.situation: When a short-term gain would cost trust
rows.under: Takes the gain. Trust is not on anyone's scorecard this quarter.
rows.justRight: Gives up the gain. Trust is the asset the next 10 years are built on.
rows.over: Refuses every commercial decision that any customer could dislike.

rows.situation: When nobody in the room has met the customer
rows.under: Argues from opinion and seniority. The customer is a guess.
rows.justRight: Brings the data, the recording, or the visit, and lets the customer's own words settle it.
rows.over: Uses 'the customer wants it' as an unfalsifiable trump card in every disagreement.
